name: epoch_operator_gated_development_harness
summary: Operator-selected external model plus explicit planner, sandbox builder, trusted verifier, and human gate stages. No internal model, hidden watcher, automatic source application, or model self-attestation exists.

loop.input: operator objective, current architecture contract, and explicitly approved evidence
loop.output: one bounded candidate or source-context request

loop.authority: guard permit plus exact sandbox transaction
loop.input: reviewed proposal digest and single-use permit
loop.output: disposable sandbox postimage and transaction evidence

loop.input: compiler, tests, analyzer, sanitizer, and optional visual evidence
loop.output: typed pass, repair, cancellation, or blocked evidence

loop.input: exact diff plus trusted verifier evidence
loop.output: stage exact live-promotion digest, request repair, or block

implemented_hooks: strict source-context request and proposal codecs
single-owner asynchronous Debug/Release compiler/contract plus asset-light HeadlessCI build/run evidence adapters
operator-approved full project-profile, generated-child, and AI-gate validation adapter
policy: Never allow blind repo write-through from planner or executor output.
Normal chat, build output, and tool output are not automatically captured or treated as training data.
Every write, child process, engine-source edit, and network-sensitive action requires declared capability and visible approval.
No model may commit, push, release, start a listener, or grant itself permission.
Tool completion requires structured trusted-host evidence, not model confidence.
